# Anchor Nutrition

> Anchor makes clinically dosed daily nutrition sticks for people on peptide/GLP-1 therapy (semaglutide, tirzepatide, etc.). Reduced appetite means reduced intake of electrolytes, protein, fiber, and micronutrients — Anchor replaces what smaller meals leave behind.

## Products

- **GI Relief** ($69.99/30 sticks): Ginger root extract (500mg), peppermint leaf (200mg), soluble fiber (5g), electrolyte blend (720mg). Targets nausea and bloating, the most common complaint on peptide therapy.
- **Muscle Guard** ($69.99/30 sticks): Whey protein isolate (15g), essential amino acids (all 9), creatine monohydrate (3g), leucine (2.5g). Protects lean muscle mass during weight loss.
- **Complete** ($69.99/30 sticks): 15+ vitamins and minerals, vitamin B12 (500mcg), vitamin D3 (2000 IU), sodium blend (1000mg). Covers the daily micronutrient floor on reduced food intake.
- **Anchor System Bundle**: All three formulas together, 30 sticks each, shipped monthly. $119.99/month subscription (save $30 vs. buying separately, cancel anytime) or $149.99 one-time.

## Key facts

- No proprietary blends — every ingredient and dose is listed on the label.
- No sugar, no fillers.
- Third-party tested, every lot.
- 97% of customers reorder after 30 days.
- Free shipping on the subscription bundle.
